f.title: Comply with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (Annex I) as mandatory
f.statement: The Good Pharmacovigilance Practices in Annex I are approved and are mandatory for marketing authorisation holders (TARC) of medicinal products.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. In force 30 calendar days counted from the first business day after publication in the Boletín Oficial (published 23-01-2013) (Art 5). Non-compliance is sanctionable under Law 16.463 and Decree 341/92 (Art 4). Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Artículo 1° — Apruébanse las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia que obran en el ANEXO I que forma parte integrante de la presente disposición, las cuales serán de cumplimiento obligatorio para los Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización (TARC) de especialidades medicinales.
rows.review_note: Review: added entry-into-force (Art 5) and sanctions (Art 4) context to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: Art 1 quote proves the approval and mandatory status for TARCs. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: Article 1 — The Good Pharmacovigilance Practices set out in ANNEX I, which forms an integral part of this disposition, are approved, and shall be of mandatory compliance for the Registration and Marketing Authorisation Holders (TARC) of medicinal products.

f.title: Maintain a pharmacovigilance system to meet obligations in time and form
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder must ensure there is a pharmacovigilance system that allows it to assume its responsibilities and obligations for the medicinal products it markets and to ensure compliance with the appropriate measures and procedures in time and form.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El Titular de una Autorización de Registro y Comercialización (TARC) debe velar por la existencia de un Sistema de Farmacovigilancia que le permita asumir sus responsabilidades y obligaciones con relación a las especialidades medicinales que comercializa y asegurar el cumplimiento de las medidas y procedimientos oportunos, en tiempo y forma.

rows.quote_en: The Holder of a Registration and Marketing Authorisation (TARC) must ensure the existence of a Pharmacovigilance System that allows it to assume its responsibilities and obligations in relation to the medicinal products it markets and to ensure compliance with the appropriate measures and procedures, in due time and form.

f.title: Keep a detailed record of all suspected ADRs in Argentina; report ICSRs preferably electronically
f.statement: The legal responsibility for pharmacovigilance obligations always lies with the MAH. Each MAH must (Mandatory) keep a detailed record of all suspected adverse reactions occurring with its medicinal products in Argentina. Individual case notifications meeting the criteria are to be communicated preferably (not strictly required) by electronic means using internationally accepted medical terminology.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records; Terminology governance

rows.quote: La responsabilidad legal derivada del cumplimiento de las obligaciones de Farmacovigilancia recae siempre en el TARC, debiendo asumir sus responsabilidades y obligaciones con respecto a las especialidades medicinales que tiene autorizadas y asegurar la adopción de las medidas oportunas cuando sea necesario. En conformidad con estas Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia cada laboratorio Titular de la Autorización de Registro y Comercialización deberá: a) Llevar un registro detallado de todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas que se produzcan con sus especialidades medicinales en Argentina. Las notificaciones de sospechas de casos individuales de reacciones adversas que cumplan los criterios señalados se comunicarán preferentemente por vía electrónica utilizando la terminología médica internacionalmente aceptada.

rows.quote_en: The legal responsibility arising from compliance with Pharmacovigilance obligations always lies with the TARC, which must assume its responsibilities and obligations with respect to the medicinal products it has authorised and ensure that appropriate measures are adopted when necessary. In accordance with these Good Pharmacovigilance Practices, each laboratory holding the Registration and Marketing Authorisation shall: a) Keep a detailed record of all suspected adverse reactions occurring with its medicinal products in Argentina. Notifications of suspected individual cases of adverse reactions that meet the indicated criteria shall be communicated preferably by electronic means using internationally accepted medical terminology.

f.statement: The MAH must record and report suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in Argentina to the ANMAT Pharmacovigilance Department within 15 calendar days following receipt of the information.

f.statement: The MAH must notify the ANMAT Pharmacovigilance Department when it detects that a pregnant woman has been exposed to a medicinal product, even if no adverse event occurs.

f.title: Report serious suspected ADRs including off-label use
f.statement: The MAH must report suspected serious adverse reactions associated with authorised medicinal products as well as those used under conditions different from those authorised.

f.statement: Notifications of non-serious reports must be sent electronically every two months in the format established by ANMAT (Form 8 of Annex II).

f.statement: The MAH must ensure that reports sent contain the minimum essential information: date of onset of the adverse event, date of start of administration of the suspect medication, patient age, complete description of the event and name of the drug(s) involved (DCA - Argentine common name - and brand).

f.statement: The MAH must ensure that suspected serious adverse reactions occurring during a post-authorisation study, of which it can reasonably be expected to be aware, are reported using the criteria in paragraph b), provided the drug is registered in Argentina.

f.title: Submit national and international suspected ADRs in a periodic safety update report (IPAS); summary only for global PSURs
f.statement: The MAH must submit to the ANMAT Pharmacovigilance Department all national and international suspected adverse reactions in a Periodic Safety Update Report (IPAS). For products of multinational companies or products licensed to national companies, this report is called PSUR and is usually written globally; in these cases only the "summary" must be submitted.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: h) Presentar ante el Departamento de Farmacovigilancia de la ANMAT todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas nacionales e internacionales en un Informe Periódico de Actualización de Seguridad (IPAS). Este informe, cuando se trate de productos de laboratorios multinacionales o de productos licenciados a laboratorios nacionales, es denominado PSUR. según sus siglas en inglés (Periodic Safety Update Report) y suele ser redactado en forma globalizada, concluyendo si se requiere alguna modificación en el prospecto o en alguna característica de comercialización. En estos casos, deberá presentarse exclusivamente el “resumen”.

In these cases, only the "summary" shall be submitted.

f.statement: The IPAS submission must be made immediately upon an ANMAT request and also periodically according to internationally established timelines, provided no other requirements were set as a condition of the marketing authorisation.

En caso de productos innovadores (moléculas nuevas, nuevas indicaciones, etc.) el TARC podrá solicitar la modificación de la periodicidad.

f.statement: In all cases of item h), the local data included for the period and product must also cover: notifications of serious and non-serious adverse events, quality deviations and problems/lack of efficacy occurring in Argentina, as well as patient complaints, market withdrawals, alerts, communications or any other situation linked to product safety occurring in Argentina and other countries; the existence of a Risk Management Plan, any changes to it or the need to implement one if not yet in place; and changes to safety information or inserts submitted or pending submission to ANMAT (if pending: the planned date; if submitted but not approved: the file number; if submitted and approved: the authorising disposition number).

f.title: Inform ANMAT at least 24 hours before any public or HCP pharmacovigilance communication
f.statement: The MAH must refrain from communicating pharmacovigilance issues about its authorised medicinal product to the public and healthcare professionals unless these issues have been communicated to ANMAT at least 24 hours in advance. The MAH must ensure the information is presented objectively, is not misleading and does not omit relevant safety information.

El TARC se cerciorará de que la información se presente de manera objetiva y no sea engañosa, y sin omitir información de seguridad relevante.

f.title: Report suspected vaccine adverse events (ESAVI) per the expedited criteria; send serious unexpected calendar-vaccine events to the national programme
f.statement: The MAH must report suspected adverse events to vaccines (ESAVI), both National Vaccination Calendar vaccines and non-calendar vaccines, according to paragraph b), except those included in active pharmacovigilance. Serious and unexpected events with calendar vaccines must also be sent to the National Programme for the Control of Vaccine-Preventable Diseases of the Ministry of Health Epidemiology Directorate.

f.exceptions: Vaccines included in active pharmacovigilance are excluded. Los eventos serios e inesperados de vacunas de calendario deberán ser, además, enviados al Programa Nacional de Control de Enfermedades Inmunoprevenibles, dependiente de la Dirección de Epidemiología del Ministerio de Salud de la Nación.

f.title: RFV acts as sole ANMAT interlocutor; register contact details; MAH provides RFV with updated safety information
f.statement: The RFV is the only valid pharmacovigilance interlocutor with the ANMAT Pharmacovigilance Department and must present himself/herself to the competent health authorities as the responsible member of the area, providing name, telephone numbers and contact e-mail address. The MAH must provide the RFV with all up-to-date safety information on each authorised product.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV); Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: El RFV será el único interlocutor válido en términos de Farmacovigilancia ante la ANMAT - Departamento de Farmacovigilancia. Por lo tanto, el RFV debe presentarse a las autoridades sanitarias competentes, como miembro responsable del área, proporcionando su nombre, teléfonos y dirección electrónica de contacto. El TARC facilitará al RFV toda la información referente a la seguridad de cada especialidad farmacéutica autorizada, convenientemente actualizada.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: two actors (RFV "debe", TARC "facilitará" future indicative) in one row. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).

Therefore, the RFV must present himself/herself to the competent health authorities as the responsible member of the area, providing his/her name, telephone numbers and contact e-mail address. The TARC shall provide the RFV with all information relating to the safety of each authorised pharmaceutical product, suitably updated.

f.title: RFV ensures case collection system, ADR reporting within timelines and IPAS preparation
f.statement: The RFV must guarantee: (a) creating and maintaining a system to collect, process and evaluate information on all suspected adverse reactions reported to company personnel and medical sales representatives; (b) reporting suspected adverse reactions within the timelines described; (c) preparing and/or reviewing the IPAS.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Submission operations; Aggregate reporting

rows.quote: El RFV garantizará el cumplimiento de las siguientes actividades: a) Crear y mantener un sistema para recopilar, tratar y evaluar la información sobre todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas notificadas al personal de la empresa y a los agentes de propaganda médica (APM). b) Notificar sospechas de reacciones adversas (SRA), cumpliendo los plazos previamente descriptos. c) Elaborar y/o revisar los Informes Periódicos de Actualización de Seguridad (IPAS).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: "garantizará" future indicative read as Mandatory (judgement call, though consistent with binding Annex I). Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: The RFV shall guarantee compliance with the following activities: a) Create and maintain a system to collect, process and evaluate information on all suspected adverse reactions reported to company personnel and to medical sales representatives (APM). b) Notify suspected adverse reactions (SRA), meeting the timelines previously described. c) Prepare and/or review the Periodic Safety Update Reports (IPAS).

f.title: RFV answers authority requests, monitors benefit-risk and ensures regulatory and RMP measures
f.statement: The RFV must guarantee: (d) responding in time and form to any request for information from the competent authorities on medicines safety; (e) permanently evaluating the benefit-risk balance during the post-authorisation period and immediately communicating to the competent authorities any information that could change it; (f) ensuring the mechanisms to comply with the regulatory measures for the products for which it is responsible, and all measures and studies in the Risk Management Plan planned in Argentina.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Submission operations; Benefit–risk review; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: d) Responder, en tiempo y forma, cualquier petición de información de las autoridades competentes en materia de seguridad de medicamentos. e) Evaluar en forma permanente la relación beneficio-riesgo durante el período de post-autorización, y comunicar inmediatamente a las autoridades competentes cualquier información que pudiera suponer un cambio en dicha relación. f) Asegurar los mecanismos necesarios para cumplir con las medidas regulatorias establecidas para los medicamentos de cuya Farmacovigilancia es responsable, así como todas aquellas medidas y estudios incluidos en el Plan de Gestión de Riesgo y que se prevean realizar en nuestro país.

f.title: Provide the RFV with resources and keep an up-to-date organisation chart
f.statement: The MAH must make available to the RFV the human and material resources needed to carry out its responsibilities adequately, and must have an up-to-date organisation chart showing the hierarchical relationship between the RFV, management and the other departments.

f.title: Cover data collection, causality, seriousness, coding, duplicates and reporting compliance in PV SOPs
f.statement: SOP documentation and instructions must cover all aspects of pharmacovigilance, including but not limited to: collection and management of PV data (from patients, healthcare professionals, medical information, quality complaints, regulatory affairs, legal departments, production sites, etc.); causality assessment; determination of seriousness and listedness; coding; avoiding duplicate reports; ensuring reporting compliance.
f.clause: 1.4.4 b.1) Sistema de calidad y POEs
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: La documentación de los POEs y las instrucciones para cubrir todos los aspectos de la Farmacovigilancia deben incluir, pero no se limitan a, las siguientes actividades: • Recolección y gestión de datos de Farmacovigilancia (de los pacientes, profesionales de la salud, los departamentos de información médica, los departamentos de reclamos de calidad, los departamentos de asuntos regulatorios, departamentos jurídicos, centros de producción, etc.). • Evaluación de la causalidad. • Determinación de la seriedad de las reacciones adversas y si están listadas. • Codificación. • Evitar la duplicación de informes. • Asegurar el cumplimiento de la presentación de informes.
rows.location: 1.4.4 b.1) Sistema de calidad y POEs
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: SOP content duty; actor inferred (quote names none). Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: The documentation of the SOPs and the instructions to cover all aspects of Pharmacovigilance must include, but are not limited to, the following activities: • Collection and management of Pharmacovigilance data (from patients, healthcare professionals, medical information departments, quality complaints departments, regulatory affairs departments, legal departments, production sites, etc.). • Causality assessment. • Determination of the seriousness of adverse reactions and whether they are listed. • Coding. • Avoiding duplication of reports. • Ensuring compliance with report submission.

f.title: Cover case follow-up, data integrity, expedited and periodic reporting, literature, signals and RMPs in PV SOPs
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance SOPs and instructions must also cover (not limited to): identification and follow-up of initial reports; use of reports from other organisations (e.g. contract research organisations); ensuring the integrity of the information in databases; review, validation and follow-up of suspected adverse reactions; data management (appropriate storage and retrieval of information, report tracking and confidentiality compliance); expedited reports to ANMAT; worldwide scientific literature monitoring; preparation and submission of IPAS; management of information requests from competent authorities; management of urgent safety restrictions; updating of safety information and inserts; signal detection; communication with competent authorities as needed; preparation and submission of Risk Management Plans (PGR).
f.clause: 1.4.4 b.1) Sistema de calidad y POEs
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: • Identificación y seguimiento de los informes iniciales. • Utilización de reportes de otras organizaciones (por ej., de Organizaciones de Investigación por Contrato). • Asegurar la integridad de la información contenida en las bases de datos. • Revisión, validación y seguimiento de sospechas de reacciones adversas. • Gestión de datos: almacenamiento apropiado y recuperación de información, seguimiento de informes y cumplimiento de la confidencialidad. • Reportes expeditos a la ANMAT. • Seguimiento de la literatura científica en todo el mundo. • Elaboración y presentación de Informes Periódicos de Actualización de Seguridad (IPAS). • Gestión de solicitudes de información por las autoridades competentes. • Gestión de las restricciones de seguridad urgentes. • Actualización de información de seguridad y de prospectos. • Detección de señales. • Comunicación con las autoridades competentes según sea necesario. • Elaboración y presentación de los Planes de Gestión de Riesgo (PGR).
rows.location: 1.4.4 b.1) Sistema de calidad y POEs

f.title: Cover key-personnel lists, SOP control, CAPA review, safety information from other departments and PV audits in PV SOPs
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance SOPs and instructions must also cover (not limited to): organisation lists identifying key personnel; control of SOPs and other procedural documents, including writing, review, approval, updating, distribution and execution; review of corrective and preventive action (CAPA) documents and processes; handling of safety information coming from other company departments (which may include, but is not limited to, medical, legal, regulatory, marketing, production, quality-deviation and complaint information); and audit of the pharmacovigilance system: conduct of pharmacovigilance audits, handling of audit findings and communication processes, and training of auditors.

f.title: Submit a corrective plan and progress evidence after inspection non-compliance
f.statement: When an inspection results in non-compliance, the MAH will be asked for a plan to correct the non-compliance and prevent recurrence. The MAH may be required to provide reports and, when necessary, evidence of progress; reinspections may follow.

f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

Se le podrá requerir al TARC reportes y, cuando sea necesario, la evidencia del progreso. Podrá haber reinspecciones en un tiempo apropiado para verificar el progreso y el éxito de estas acciones.

f.title: Submit IPAS six-monthly for 2 years, annually for 2 years, then every 3 years
f.statement: From the marketing date, the MAH must submit IPAS: every six months during the first two years after marketing starts; annually in the following two years; every three years from the 5th year, or as established.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: From marketing date: six-monthly for first 2 years; annually for next 2 years; every 3 years from year 5, or as established
rows.quote: A partir de la fecha de comercialización, el TARC deberá presentar los IPAS de acuerdo a la siguiente periodicidad: • Semestralmente durante los dos primeros años tras el inicio de la comercialización. • Anualmente, en los dos años siguientes. • Cada tres años a partir del 5º año, o según se establezca.

f.title: Submit IPAS at RMP/intensive-PV periodicity or immediately on request
f.statement: In particular situations, the MAH must submit IPAS with the periodicity set in Risk Management Plans, Intensive Pharmacovigilance Programmes or other pharmacovigilance modalities that require it, and immediately upon request of the regulatory authority.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: As set in the RMP/intensive PV programme; immediately upon authority request
rows.quote: En algunas situaciones particulares, el TARC deberá presentar los IPAS: • Con la periodicidad establecida en los Planes de Gestión de Riesgo, en los Programas de Farmacovigilancia Intensiva u en otras modalidades de Farmacovigilancia que lo requieran, en caso de corresponder. • Inmediatamente a partir de la solicitud de la autoridad regulatoria.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "el TARC deberá" with both triggers. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: In some particular situations, the TARC shall submit the IPAS: • With the periodicity established in the Risk Management Plans, in the Intensive Pharmacovigilance Programmes or in other Pharmacovigilance modalities that require it, where applicable. • Immediately upon request of the regulatory authority.

f.title: Multinational or licensed products may follow international PSUR timelines with prior notice
f.statement: For products marketed by multinational companies or licensed to national companies, the MAH may submit IPAS according to international timelines, with prior notice to the local regulatory authority.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El TARC podrá presentar los IPAS de acuerdo a los plazos internacionales, en el caso de productos comercializados por laboratorios multinacionales o de productos licenciados a laboratorios nacionales, previo aviso a la autoridad regulatoria local.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "podrá" with actor and condition. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: The TARC may submit the IPAS according to international timelines, in the case of products marketed by multinational laboratories or products licensed to national laboratories, with prior notice to the local regulatory authority.

f.title: Apply standard periodicity from the start for biologicals, special-safety products and new formulations/indications
f.statement: Permitted: most similar products can be placed in the same IPAS cycle as the innovator, in most cases the three-yearly period. Mandatory: the standard periodicity applies from the start for biological products with antecedents, products with specific safety issues or under intensive surveillance (isotretinoin, clozapine, thalidomide, etc.) and new formulations, routes of administration or indications.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: La mayoría de los productos similares pueden ser ubicados en el mismo ciclo que el innovador. En la mayoría de los casos, esto será en el período trianual. Sin embargo, la periodicidad estándar se aplicará desde el inicio para especialidades medicinales de origen biológico con antecedentes, para medicamentos con cuestiones de seguridad específicas o de vigilancia intensiva (isotretinoína, clozapina, talidomida, etc.) y para nuevas formulaciones, vías de administración o indicaciones.

However, the standard periodicity shall apply from the start for medicinal products of biological origin with antecedents, for medicinal products with specific safety issues or under intensive surveillance (isotretinoin, clozapine, thalidomide, etc.) and for new formulations, routes of administration or indications.

f.title: MAH may request a justified change to IPAS periodicity
f.statement: The MAH may request modification of the above periodicities, with due justification.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El TARC podrá solicitar la modificación de las periodicidades arriba citadas, justificando debidamente dicha solicitud.

f.title: Have formal procedures to include all relevant cases, including clinical trial cases, in the IPAS
f.statement: The MAH must have formal procedures to ensure all relevant cases are included in the IPAS. Relevant clinical trial cases, including suspected serious unexpected (RAMSI) or serious (RAMS) adverse drug reactions during the period, must be included. All safety information from studies (clinical, non-clinical and epidemiological) during the period must be discussed if it alters the benefit-risk profile.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El TARC debe tener procedimientos formales para asegurarse de que todos los casos pertinentes sean incluidos en el IPAS. Los casos relevantes de ensayos clínicos, incluyendo reacciones adversas medicamentosas serias e inesperadas (RAMSI) o reacciones adversas medicamentosas serias (RAMS) sospechados durante el período reportado deben ser incluidos en el IPAS. Toda la información de seguridad concerniente a un producto que provenga de un estudio (clínico, no clínico y epidemiológico) durante el período cubierto debe discutirse si de alguna manera altera el perfil beneficio-riesgo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "El TARC debe" and "deben" for all parts. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: The TARC must have formal procedures to ensure that all relevant cases are included in the IPAS. Relevant cases from clinical trials, including serious unexpected adverse drug reactions (RAMSI) or serious adverse drug reactions (RAMS) suspected during the reporting period, must be included in the IPAS. All safety information concerning a product that comes from a study (clinical, non-clinical and epidemiological) during the period covered must be discussed if it in any way alters the benefit-risk profile.

f.title: Always include and analyse pediatric, elderly and pregnancy data in IPAS; six-monthly IPAS for 2 years after a new pediatric indication
f.statement: Safety information on the pediatric population, people over 65 and pregnant women must always be included and analysed in the IPAS; if there is none or very little, this must still be reported. Adding a pediatric indication to a marketed product changes the periodicity: IPAS must be submitted every six months for the next two years, paying attention to pediatric use.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.deadline: After a new pediatric indication: six-monthly IPAS for the next two years
rows.quote: La información de seguridad para la población pediátrica, mayores de 65 años y embarazadas deberá ser siempre incluida y analizada en los IPAS. Si no hubiese, o hubiese muy poca información sobre estas poblaciones, deberá reportarse en el IPAS de cualquier manera. La adición de una indicación pediátrica a un medicamento ya comercializado modificará la periodicidad, debiendo presentarse los IPAS semestralmente durante los próximos dos años. Estos reportes deberán prestar atención al uso pediátrico.

rows.quote_en: Safety information for the pediatric population, persons over 65 years of age and pregnant women shall always be included and analysed in the IPAS. If there is no information, or very little information, on these populations, this shall be reported in the IPAS in any case. The addition of a pediatric indication to an already marketed medicinal product will change the periodicity, the IPAS having to be submitted every six months for the next two years. These reports shall pay attention to pediatric use.

f.title: RFV ensures IPAS quality-control procedures for accurate and complete data
f.statement: Since the RFV is responsible for writing the IPAS, the RFV must ensure procedures exist to check that data presented in these reports are accurate and complete.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Dado que el RFV es responsable de la redacción del IPAS, debe asegurarse de que existan procedimientos para controlar que los datos presentados en estos reportes sean exactos y completos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit RFV "debe asegurarse". Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: Since the RFV is responsible for writing the IPAS, he/she must ensure that procedures exist to check that the data presented in these reports are accurate and complete.

f.title: Prepare an executive summary at the start of each IPAS
f.statement: The MAH must prepare an executive summary of each IPAS describing the most important information, placed at the start of the IPAS and including: worldwide authorisation status and authorised indications; other relevant regulatory information for the period (highlighting any restriction of use); patient exposure; number of new cases in the period and cumulative numbers; particular safety situations investigated; final conclusions; and any review of safety situations performed by the MAH.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: El TARC debe preparar un resumen ejecutivo de cada IPAS que contenga una descripción de la información más importante. Esta sección debe estar en el inicio del IPAS y debe incluir información resumida de lo siguiente: • El estatus de autorización mundial del producto (incluyendo un listado de países donde el producto está autorizado/comercializado) y las indicaciones autorizadas. • Otra información relevante regulatoria relacionada al período cubierto en el IPAS (por ej., cualquier información de restricción de uso debe ser resaltada). • Datos de exposición de pacientes. • Número de nuevos casos recibidos durante el período cubierto por el IPAS. y los números de casos acumulados. • Situaciones particulares de seguridad investigadas. • Conclusiones finales del IPAS. • Cuando el TARC haya realizado una revisión de una o más situaciones de seguridad, esto debe estar descripto en el resumen del IPAS.

rows.quote_en: The TARC must prepare an executive summary of each IPAS containing a description of the most important information. This section must be at the beginning of the IPAS and must include summarised information on the following: • The worldwide authorisation status of the product (including a list of countries where the product is authorised/marketed) and the authorised indications. • Other relevant regulatory information related to the period covered by the IPAS (e.g. any information on restriction of use must be highlighted). • Patient exposure data. • Number of new cases received during the period covered by the IPAS, and the cumulative case numbers. • Particular safety situations investigated. • Final conclusions of the IPAS. • When the TARC has carried out a review of one or more safety situations, this must be described in the IPAS summary.

f.title: Present the IPAS as a single integrated document referencing included and excluded products
f.statement: The MAH must present the IPAS as a single comprehensive document, taking previous IPAS into account. Products included and excluded must be referenced and exclusions explained. If the same product IPAS will be submitted by another MAH, possible duplicate data must be considered.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: El TARC debe presentar el IPAS como un documento integral y único, pero a la vez teniendo en cuenta los IPAS previos. Se debe hacer referencia al (los) producto(s) incluidos en el IPAS, y a los excluidos. Estas exclusiones deben ser explicadas, por ejemplo, si son cubiertas en otro IPAS (como en el caso de un producto combinado). Si es sabido que el IPAS del mismo producto será presentado por otro TARC debe ser considerada la posibilidad de presentar datos duplicados.
rows.review_note: Review: added the section 2.6 model/alternative-format context to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: explicit "El TARC debe", but section 2.6 allows other international formats (e.g. PBRER). Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: The TARC must present the IPAS as a comprehensive, single document, while taking previous IPAS into account. Reference must be made to the product(s) included in the IPAS and to those excluded. These exclusions must be explained, for example, if they are covered in another IPAS (as in the case of a combination product). If it is known that the IPAS for the same product will be submitted by another TARC, the possibility of presenting duplicate data must be considered.

f.title: Give cumulative worldwide authorisation status data in the IPAS
f.statement: The worldwide authorisation status section of the IPAS must provide cumulative information on marketing regulatory measures in all countries: authorisation and subsequent renewal dates; any change to the authorisation relevant to safety; treatment indications and special populations covered where relevant; refusals of approval by specific regulatory authorities, with explanation; withdrawal of the registration application by the company if related to safety or efficacy; marketing start dates; dates on which the authorisation was suspended or revoked by the authority or voluntarily by the MAH; trade names.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Esta sección del IPAS provee información acumulada respecto de medidas regulatorias de comercialización en todos los países, en relación a lo siguiente: • Fechas de autorización y renovación subsiguientes. • Cualquier modificación de la autorización, si es relevante para la seguridad. • Indicaciones de tratamiento y poblaciones especiales cubiertas cuando sea relevante. • Rechazo de la aprobación, incluyendo explicación, por las autoridades regulatorias específicas. • Desistimiento de la solicitud de registro por parte de la compañía, si está relacionada con la seguridad o la eficacia. • Fechas de inicio de comercialización. • Fechas en que la autorización de comercialización ha sido suspendida o revocada por la autoridad regulatoria o voluntariamente por el TARC. • Nombres comerciales.

rows.quote_en: This section of the IPAS provides cumulative information on marketing regulatory measures in all countries, in relation to the following: • Dates of authorisation and subsequent renewal. • Any change to the authorisation, if relevant to safety. • Treatment indications and special populations covered, when relevant. • Refusal of approval, including explanation, by specific regulatory authorities. • Withdrawal of the registration application by the company, if related to safety or efficacy. • Marketing start dates. • Dates on which the marketing authorisation was suspended or revoked by the regulatory authority or voluntarily by the TARC. • Trade names.

f.title: Report worldwide authorisation status cumulatively, preferably tabulated
f.statement: Worldwide authorisation status information must preferably be provided in tabulated form. Where there are important differences between countries in indications, treated populations or doses reflecting different types of patient exposure, this information must be made explicit.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: La información debe ser provista preferentemente en forma tabulada. Típicamente, las indicaciones de uso, las poblaciones tratadas y las dosis son iguales en la mayoría de los países donde el medicamento se comercializa. Sin embargo, cuando haya diferencias importantes que reflejen los diferentes tipos de exposición de pacientes, esta información debe explicitarse.

rows.quote_en: The information must preferably be provided in tabulated form. Typically, the indications for use, the populations treated and the doses are the same in most of the countries where the medicinal product is marketed. However, when there are important differences reflecting different types of patient exposure, this information must be made explicit.

f.title: Include safety actions taken by authorities or the MAH during the period
f.statement: The IPAS must include details of safety-related measures taken nationally and internationally during the period, such as withdrawal, suspension or cancellation of registration, failure to renew, restrictions on distribution/use, suspension of clinical trials, dose changes, changes in populations or indications, formulation changes and safety restrictions.
f.clause: 2.6.4 Actualización de acciones tomadas por razones de seguridad
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Esta sección debe incluir detalles de los siguientes tipos de medidas relacionadas con la seguridad del producto tomadas durante el período cubierto por el IPAS, ocurridas nacional e internacionalmente. • Retiro, suspensión o cancelación del certificado de registro del producto. • Imposibilidad de obtener la reinscripción del certificado de registro del producto. • Restricciones en la distribución, uso, condición de venta, etc. • Suspensión de ensayos clínicos. • Modificación de las dosis. • Cambios en las poblaciones tratadas o indicaciones. • Cambios en la formulación. • Restricciones de seguridad.
rows.location: 2.6.4 Actualización de acciones tomadas por razones de seguridad
rows.review_note: Review: added the section 2.6 model/alternative-format context to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: This section must include details of the following types of measures related to the safety of the product taken during the period covered by the IPAS, occurring nationally and internationally. • Withdrawal, suspension or cancellation of the product registration certificate. • Inability to obtain re-registration of the product registration certificate. • Restrictions on distribution, use, sales condition, etc. • Suspension of clinical trials. • Dose changes. • Changes in the populations treated or indications. • Changes in the formulation. • Safety restrictions.

f.title: Describe changes to reference safety information with the modified sections
f.statement: Changes to safety information (new contraindications, precautions, warnings, adverse reactions or interactions) made during the IPAS period must be clearly described, presenting the modified sections.
f.clause: 2.6.5 Cambios en la información de referencia de seguridad
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Cambios en la información de seguridad, tales como nuevas contraindicaciones, precauciones, advertencias, reacciones adversas o interacciones, realizados durante el período cubierto por el IPAS deben describirse claramente, con presentación de las secciones modificadas.
rows.location: 2.6.5 Cambios en la información de referencia de seguridad

Double-check: Below 90: IPAS section-content duty with the actor (MAH) inferred; section 2.6 also allows other international formats (e.g. PBRER). Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: Changes to the safety information, such as new contraindications, precautions, warnings, adverse reactions or interactions, made during the period covered by the IPAS must be clearly described, presenting the modified sections.

f.title: Present patient exposure for the IPAS period with method or justification
f.statement: Where possible, a precise number of exposed patients covering the same period as the IPAS must be presented; when difficult, an estimate with the calculation method; a justification must be given if the precise number cannot be obtained. Other exposure measures, such as patient-days, number of prescriptions or number of units sold, may be used instead.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Cuando sea posible, debe presentarse un cálculo preciso del número de pacientes expuestos, el cual debe cubrir el mismo período que el IPAS. Cuando resulte muy dificultoso obtener y validar datos precisos de exposición, debe aportarse el estimado de los pacientes, junto con el método utilizado para realizar el cálculo. Debe presentarse una justificación si el número preciso de pacientes es imposible de obtener. En su lugar, pueden utilizarse otras medidas de exposición, tales como pacientes-días, número de prescripciones, número de unidades vendidas, etc.
rows.review_note: Review: added the section 2.6 model/alternative-format context to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: mixed "debe"/"pueden" row; IPAS section-content duty with the actor (MAH) inferred; section 2.6 also allows other international formats (e.g. PBRER). Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: Where possible, a precise calculation of the number of exposed patients must be presented, which must cover the same period as the IPAS. When it is very difficult to obtain and validate precise exposure data, the estimate of patients must be provided, together with the method used to make the calculation. A justification must be presented if the precise number of patients is impossible to obtain. Instead, other measures of exposure may be used, such as patient-days, number of prescriptions, number of units sold, etc.

f.title: Stratify IPAS exposure data by relevant variables; extrapolation from partial periods allowed with justification
f.statement: Permitted: exposure may also be given as patient-time of exposure (days-months-years), and the Defined Daily Dose (DDD) concept may be used to arrive at other estimates. Permitted: when exposure data are based on a period that does not fully cover the IPAS period, the MAH may extrapolate from the available data, with adequate justification. Mandatory: where relevant, exposure information must be stratified by significant variables such as age, indication, dose and duration of treatment.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: De esta manera, dada la dificultad para realizar las estimaciones, la información de los pacientes expuestos puede también ser provista como paciente - tiempo de exposición (días-meses-años). Asimismo, se puede utilizar el concepto de Dosis Diaria Definida (DDD) para arribar a otros estimados. Cuando los datos de pacientes expuestos estén basados en información de un período que no cubre completamente el período del IPAS, el TARC podrá, justificando adecuadamente, extrapolar usando los datos disponibles. Cuando sea relevante, la información sobre exposición debe estratificarse de acuerdo con variables significativas tales como edad, indicación, dosis y duración de tratamiento.
rows.review_note: Review: mixed-level row kept whole (level Mandatory for the stratification duty); statement now labels the Permitted parts ("puede", "se puede", "podrá") and the Mandatory part ("debe"). rows.quote_en: Thus, given the difficulty of making estimates, the information on exposed patients may also be provided as patient-time of exposure (days-months-years). Likewise, the concept of Defined Daily Dose (DDD) may be used to arrive at other estimates. When the exposed-patient data are based on information from a period that does not fully cover the IPAS period, the TARC may, with adequate justification, extrapolate using the available data. When relevant, exposure information must be stratified according to significant variables such as age, indication, dose and duration of treatment.

f.title: Describe and analyse selected individual cases with new safety information
f.statement: The IPAS must include a description and analysis of selected cases containing new or relevant safety information, with a description of the selection criteria.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Esta sección debe incluir una descripción y análisis de casos seleccionados conteniendo nueva o relevante información de seguridad. Se proveerá una descripción del criterio utilizado para seleccionar los casos.

rows.quote_en: This section must include a description and analysis of selected cases containing new or relevant safety information. A description of the criteria used to select the cases shall be provided.

f.title: Present cases as line listings, avoiding duplicates; listed spontaneous cases in an annex
f.statement: Cases must be included in listings, trying to avoid duplicates from literature and regulatory sources: all serious and non-serious unlisted reactions from spontaneous reports, literature or regulatory authorities; all serious reactions from post-marketing and other studies (including RMP studies). Listed serious and non-serious spontaneous reactions are presented as an annex to the IPAS.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: Los casos deben ser incluidos en listados. Se debe intentar evitar duplicados de la literatura y de fuentes regulatorias. Estos casos incluyen: • Todas las reacciones adversas serias y no serias (no listadas) de reportes espontáneos, de la literatura o de las autoridades regulatorias específicas. • Todas las reacciones adversas serias que provengan de estudios postcomercialización y otros (incluyendo los que son parte del Plan de Gestión de Riesgo). Además los siguientes casos se presentarán como anexo al IPAS: • Reacciones serias y no serias listadas espontáneas.

rows.quote_en: Cases must be included in listings. An attempt must be made to avoid duplicates from the literature and regulatory sources. These cases include: • All serious and non-serious (unlisted) adverse reactions from spontaneous reports, from the literature or from specific regulatory authorities. • All serious adverse reactions coming from post-marketing and other studies (including those that are part of the Risk Management Plan). In addition, the following cases shall be presented as an annex to the IPAS: • Spontaneous listed serious and non-serious reactions.

f.title: List each patient once in IPAS line listings under the most serious reaction
f.statement: Line listings must include each patient only once, regardless of how many adverse reactions were reported for the case. If there is more than one reaction, all must be mentioned, but the case must be listed under the most serious adverse reaction, as determined by the MAH. Different reactions experienced by the same patient at different times are treated as separate reports, so the same patient is then included in the listing more than once.

rows.quote: Los listados deben incluir cada paciente solamente una vez, sin importar cuántas reacciones adversas hayan sido reportadas para el caso. Si hay más de una reacción, deben ser todas mencionadas, pero el caso debe ser listado según la reacción adversa más seria a ser determinada por el TARC. Es posible que el mismo paciente experimente reacciones adversas diferentes en distintos momentos. Estas situaciones serán tratadas como reportes separados. En estas circunstancias, el mismo paciente será incluido en el listado más de una vez.

In these circumstances, the same patient shall be included in the listing more than once.

f.title: Include required headings in IPAS line listings
f.statement: The listing must include: MAH case number; country of occurrence; source; patient age and sex; suspect drug dose (and, when relevant, dosage form and route); date of reaction; dates of administration; description of reaction; outcome (using the worst outcome for multiple reactions).

rows.quote: El listado deberá incluir los siguientes encabezados: • Número de caso asignado por el TARC. • País en que el caso ocurrió. • Fuente (por ej., ensayo clínico, literatura, espontáneo, autoridad regulatoria). • Edad y sexo de pacientes. • Dosis del medicamento sospechoso (y, cuando sea relevante, otros datos tales como forma farmacéutica y vía de administración). • Fecha de la reacción adversa. • Fechas de administración del medicamento. • Descripción de la reacción adversa. • Resultado (por ej., resuelto, fatal, mejorado, secuela, desconocido). Esto debe indicar las consecuencias de las reacciones adversas para el paciente, utilizando el peor de los diferentes resultados para múltiples reacciones.

This must indicate the consequences of the adverse reactions for the patient, using the worst of the different outcomes for multiple reactions.

f.statement: The IPAS must report the existence of any Risk Management Plan and analyse any relevant data arising from it.

f.title: Provide an overall safety evaluation of period and cumulative data
f.statement: The MAH must provide a concise analysis of all data collected in the period with an assessment of their significance, and review cumulative experience highlighting new information on: changes in characteristics of listed reactions; unlisted serious and non-serious reactions; increased reporting frequency of listed reactions; interactions; overdose; abuse or misuse; pregnancy or lactation; special patient groups; long-term treatment; prescribing/medication errors.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: El TARC debe aportar un análisis conciso de todos los datos recopilados durante el período en cuestión, incluyendo una evaluación de la significación de dichos datos. El TARC debe, además, rever la experiencia acumulada y resaltar cualquier nueva información con respecto a: • Un cambio en las características de las reacciones listadas, por ej., seriedad, resultado, población. • Reacciones no listadas, serias y no serias. • Una frecuencia incrementada de reporte de reacciones listadas. • Interacciones. • Experiencia con sobredosis, deliberada o accidental, y su tratamiento. • Abuso o mal uso. • Experiencias positivas o negativas durante el embarazo o lactancia. • Experiencia en grupos especiales de pacientes. • Efectos en el tratamiento a largo plazo. • Errores de prescripción/de medicación.

rows.quote_en: The TARC must provide a concise analysis of all data collected during the period in question, including an assessment of the significance of those data. The TARC must also review the cumulative experience and highlight any new information regarding: • A change in the characteristics of listed reactions, e.g. seriousness, outcome, population. • Unlisted reactions, serious and non-serious. • An increased reporting frequency of listed reactions. • Interactions. • Experience with overdose, deliberate or accidental, and its treatment. • Abuse or misuse. • Positive or negative experiences during pregnancy or lactation. • Experience in special patient groups. • Effects of long-term treatment. • Prescribing/medication errors.

f.title: Conclude on benefit-risk and submit any package insert change with the IPAS
f.statement: The conclusion must address benefit-risk in the context of IPAS data, indicate data not consistent with previous experience and reference safety information, and specify and justify any recommended or initiated action. Having decided to modify the package insert, the MAH must submit the application at the same time as the IPAS or, if not possible, indicate a date for it.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish. Content of the IPAS model in Annex I section 2.6; section 2.6 states that other internationally accepted formats (e.g. periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports) may also be taken into account.

rows.quote: La conclusión debe tratar el balance beneficio-riesgo en el contexto de los datos presentados en el IPAS. También se indicarán qué datos de seguridad no están en concordancia con la experiencia acumulada previa y la información de referencia de seguridad. Se especificará y justificará cualquier acción recomendada o iniciada. La necesidad de modificar el prospecto será tratada cuando haya una inconsistencia entre la información de referencia y el prospecto previo. Habiendo tomado la decisión de modificar el prospecto, el TARC debe presentar la solicitud al mismo tiempo que el IPAS o, si esto no es posible, indicar una fecha para dicha solicitud.

rows.quote_en: The conclusion must address the benefit-risk balance in the context of the data presented in the IPAS. It shall also indicate which safety data are not consistent with the previous cumulative experience and the reference safety information. Any recommended or initiated action shall be specified and justified. The need to modify the package insert shall be addressed when there is an inconsistency between the reference information and the previous package insert. Having taken the decision to modify the package insert, the TARC must submit the application at the same time as the IPAS or, if this is not possible, indicate a date for that application.

f.title: Always submit the RMP; add a risk minimisation plan when additional measures are planned
f.statement: If only routine activities are required, no minimisation plan is needed; if additional activities are planned, the MAH must present a minimisation plan with both additional and routine activities. The RMP must always be submitted, regardless of whether a minimisation plan is required.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Si se requieren sólo actividades de rutina, no es necesaria la presentación de un plan de minimización de riesgo. Si se planean actividades adicionales, el TARC deberá presentar en la Parte II del PGR un plan de minimización de riesgo que contenga tanto las actividades adicionales como las de rutina. Es importante aclarar que el PGR debe presentarse siempre, independientemente de si requerirá un plan de minimización de riesgo.

rows.quote_en: If only routine activities are required, submission of a risk minimisation plan is not necessary. If additional activities are planned, the TARC shall submit in Part II of the PGR a risk minimisation plan containing both the additional and the routine activities. It is important to clarify that the PGR must always be submitted, regardless of whether it will require a risk minimisation plan.

f.title: Submit an RMP with new registrations of new actives, biologicals/vaccines and other listed cases
f.statement: For the registration of a medicinal product the MAH must submit an RMP with the application for: a product containing a new active ingredient; a biological product, including vaccines; a similar product where a safety problem of the reference product requires risk minimisation; a fixed combination without evidence of marketing in Annex I countries of Decree 150/92; at the request of the national regulatory authority; a product registered under special conditions (e.g. orphan).

f.title: Submit an RMP with major variations, on own safety concern, or on ANMAT request
f.statement: For changes to the registration the MAH must submit an RMP with applications for important changes implying a possible risk (new dose, dosage form, route, indication, new manufacturing process of a biological, etc.) or at authority request; on its own initiative when it identifies a safety problem at any stage of the lifecycle; and at the authority request pre- or post-authorisation. In any other non-mandatory situation, the MAH and the authority must analyse the need for an RMP.

rows.quote: b) Para modificaciones en el Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM), el TARC deberá presentar un PGR: • Con la solicitud de aprobación de cambios importantes en la especialidad medicinal: nueva dosis, nueva forma farmacéutica, nueva vía de administración, cambios en la indicación, nuevo proceso de fabricación de un producto biológico, etc., que implique un posible riesgo. • A pedido de la Autoridad Regulatoria Nacional. c) Por iniciativa del TARC, al identificar un problema de seguridad con el medicamento en cualquier estadio de su ciclo de vida. d) A pedido de la Autoridad Regulatoria Nacional (tanto pre como post autorización). En cualquier otra situación que no sea obligatoria, el TARC y la Autoridad Nacional deberán analizar la necesidad de crear un PGR.

In any other situation that is not mandatory, the TARC and the National Authority shall analyse the need to create a PGR.

f.title: Safety specification summarises identified and potential risks, missing information and at-risk populations; follow the recommended structure
f.statement: Mandatory: the safety specification must summarise identified risks, potential risks and missing information, and must include potentially at-risk populations; it must help industry and the regulatory authority identify any need for special data collection and facilitate the construction of the pharmacovigilance plan; the RMP will also found the evaluation of the need for risk minimisation activities and, where appropriate, the risk minimisation plan. Recommended: MAHs are recommended to follow the structure provided. Permitted: they may include additional elements depending on the nature of the product and its development programme.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Deben ser un resumen de los riesgos identificados de un producto medicinal, riesgos potenciales e información faltante. También deben incluir poblaciones potencialmente en riesgo. Las especificaciones de seguridad deben ayudar a la industria farmacéutica y a la autoridad regulatoria a identificar cualquier necesidad de recolección especial de datos y también facilitar la construcción del Plan de Farmacovigilancia. El PGR también fundará las bases para la evaluación de la necesidad de actividades de minimización de riesgo, y cuando sea apropiado, el plan de minimización de riesgos. Se recomienda a los TARC que sigan la estructura que se proveerá en estos ítems, aunque pueden incluir elementos adicionales, dependiendo de la naturaleza del producto y su programa de desarrollo.

The safety specifications must help the pharmaceutical industry and the regulatory authority to identify any need for special data collection and also facilitate the construction of the Pharmacovigilance Plan. The PGR will also lay the foundations for the evaluation of the need for risk minimisation activities and, when appropriate, the risk minimisation plan. TARCs are recommended to follow the structure that will be provided in these items, although they may include additional elements, depending on the nature of the product and its development programme.

f.title: Present non-clinical safety data not adequately addressed by clinical data in the safety specification
f.statement: Within the safety specification, the non-clinical section must present non-clinical data not adequately evaluated by clinical data, such as: toxicity (neurotoxicity, genotoxicity, etc.); general pharmacology (cardiovascular including QT prolongation, nervous system, etc.); drug interactions; other toxicity information.

When the drug is marketed, the MAH must provide data on patients already exposed.
f.clause: 3.3.2.1 Limitaciones de la base de datos de seguridad
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Serán consideradas las limitaciones de la base de datos (por ej., relacionado al tamaño de la población en estudio, criterios de inclusión y exclusión de los estudios). Se deben discutir las implicaciones de dichas limitaciones con respecto a la predicción de seguridad de la especialidad medicinal en el mercado. Se debe hacer particular referencia a poblaciones que puedan ser expuestas durante el uso del producto en la práctica médica. Exposición Post comercialización Cuando la droga esté comercializada, el TARC debe proveer los datos de los pacientes ya expuestos.

f.title: Discuss populations not studied pre-authorisation in the safety specification
f.statement: The safety specification must discuss which populations have not been studied or have been little studied, including (not limited to): children; elderly; pregnant or breastfeeding women; patients with relevant co-morbidity such as hepatic or renal disorders; patients with severe diseases different from those studied in clinical trials; populations with relevant genetic polymorphisms; patients of different racial or ethnic origins.

Las poblaciones consideradas para discusión deben incluir (no limitarse únicamente a las siguientes): • Niños. • Ancianos. • Embarazadas o mujeres lactando. • Pacientes con co-morbilidad relevante, como desórdenes hepáticos o renales. • Pacientes con enfermedades severas distintas a las estudiadas en los ensayos clínicos. • Poblaciones que presenten polimorfismos genéticos relevantes. • Pacientes con diferentes orígenes raciales o étnicos.

The populations considered for discussion must include (not be limited only to the following): • Children. • Elderly. • Pregnant or breastfeeding women. • Patients with relevant co-morbidity, such as hepatic or renal disorders. • Patients with severe diseases different from those studied in clinical trials. • Populations presenting relevant genetic polymorphisms. • Patients of different racial or ethnic origins.

f.title: List and describe important identified and potential risks requiring further evaluation
f.statement: The adverse reactions section of the safety specification must list important identified risks and potential risks requiring further analysis or evaluation. For identified risks, detailed information must be included on the most important adverse reactions (serious or frequent and with an impact on the risk-benefit balance), with evidence on causality, seriousness, frequency, reversibility and at-risk groups where available, and a discussion of risk factors and potential mechanisms. For important potential risks, the risks must be described and the evidence that led to the conclusion that it is a risk must be presented.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Esta sección debe listar los riesgos identificados importantes y riesgos potenciales que requieren mayor análisis o evaluación. • Riesgos identificados que requieren mayor evaluación Será incluida información detallada de las reacciones adversas identificadas como más importantes, que incluirá aquellas serias o frecuentes y que además presenten un impacto en el balance riesgo-beneficio. La información incluirá la evidencia basada en relación causal, seriedad, frecuencia, reversibilidad y grupos de riesgo, si hay disponible. También se discutirán los factores de riesgo y mecanismos potenciales. Estas reacciones adversas usualmente incluyen mayor información de evaluación en el Plan de Farmacovigilancia. • Riesgos potenciales que requieren mayor evaluación En esta sección se describirán los riesgos potenciales importantes. Se presentará la evidencia que llevó a la conclusión que se trata de un riesgo.

f.title: Discuss interactions and the epidemiology of the indications in the safety specification
f.statement: Potential and identified pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions must be discussed; for each, the evidence including possible mechanisms and potential health risks for the different indications and populations is summarised, and it must be stated which interactions require further evaluation. The epidemiology of the indications must be discussed, including incidence, prevalence, mortality and relevant co-morbidities, and information on risk factors where available.

rows.quote: Se discutirán las interacciones farmacocinéticas y farmacodinámicas potenciales e identificadas. Para cada una, se resumirá la evidencia que incluye sus posibles mecanismos y los potenciales riesgos en salud para las distintas indicaciones y distintas poblaciones. Se debe aclarar cuáles de las interacciones requieren mayor evaluación. 3.3.2.5. Epidemiología La epidemiología de las indicaciones debe ser discutida, y debe incluir incidencia, prevalencia, mortalidad y co-morbilidades relevantes. De estar disponible, se incluirá también la información acerca de factores de riesgo.

The epidemiology of the indications must be discussed, and must include incidence, prevalence, mortality and relevant co-morbidities. If available, information on risk factors shall also be included.

f.title: Identify pharmacological class effects and justify any class risk not considered a concern
f.statement: The safety specification must identify risks believed to be related to the pharmacological class. If a risk commonly related to the class does not appear to be a safety concern, this must be justified.

f.title: Discuss overdose, infectious transmission, illegal and off-label (incl. pediatric) use in the safety specification
f.statement: The MAH must discuss potential overdose, potential transmission of infectious agents, potential illegal use, potential off-label use and potential off-label use in pediatric populations; significant potential risks are treated as important risks with minimisation discussed.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El TARC debe discutir los siguientes ítems. Si se cree que el riesgo potencial es significativo, el ítem será identificado como un riesgo importante y las maneras para reducirlo o minimizarlo serán discutidas en “evaluación de la necesidad de actividades de minimización de riesgo”. En este contexto “significativo” significa que hay una posibilidad razonable de que ocurra. • Sobredosis potencial (por ej., margen de seguridad estrecho). • Potencial transmisión de agentes infecciosos. • Potencial uso ilegal. • Potencial uso fuera de prospecto (off-label). • Potencial uso fuera de prospecto en poblaciones pediátricas.

If the potential risk is believed to be significant, the item shall be identified as an important risk and the ways to reduce or minimise it shall be discussed in the "evaluation of the need for risk minimisation activities". In this context "significant" means that there is a reasonable possibility that it will occur. • Potential overdose (e.g. narrow safety margin). • Potential transmission of infectious agents. • Potential illegal use. • Potential off-label use. • Potential off-label use in pediatric populations.

f.title: Summarise important risks and missing information and base the PV plan on the safety specification
f.statement: At the end of the safety specification a summary of important identified risks, important potential risks and important missing information must be included; based on this summary the MAH must provide a pharmacovigilance plan and the assessment of the need for risk minimisation activities. The pharmacovigilance plan must be based on the safety specification and must propose actions for the identified safety problems; it complements, and does not replace, current signal detection procedures.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.quote: Al final de las especificaciones de seguridad se incluirá un resumen acerca de: • Riesgos identificados importantes. • Riesgos potenciales importantes. • Información faltante importante. Basado en este resumen, el TARC proveerá un Plan de Farmacovigilancia y la evaluación de la necesidad de actividades de minimización de riesgos. 3.4. Plan de Farmacovigilancia El Plan de Farmacovigilancia debe basarse en las especificaciones de seguridad y debe proponer acciones para los problemas de seguridad identificados. Es importante aclarar que sólo una proporción de los riesgos son previamente identificados y el Plan de Farmacovigilancia no reemplaza, sino que complementa los procedimientos actuales para la detección de señales.

f.title: Assess the need for risk minimisation for each safety concern
f.statement: For each safety problem, the MAH must evaluate the need for risk minimisation activities; if required, these activities must be described in the Risk Minimisation Plan.

f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Para cada problema de seguridad, el TARC debe evaluar la necesidad de actividades de minimización de riesgo. Algunas situaciones de seguridad podrán ser resueltas con las acciones propuestas en el Plan de Farmacovigilancia, pero para otras, el riesgo puede ser de una naturaleza particular y de seriedad tal que requieran actividades de minimización de riesgos. Es posible que estas actividades estén limitadas a asegurar que las precauciones adecuadas estén incluidas en los prospectos. Sin embargo, para algunos riesgos, las actividades de rutina no son suficientes. De ser requeridas, estas actividades deben ser descriptas en el Plan de Minimización de Riesgos.
rows.location: 3.5 Evaluación de las necesidades de actividades de minimización de riesgo

rows.quote_en: For each safety problem, the TARC must evaluate the need for risk minimisation activities. Some safety situations may be resolved with the actions proposed in the Pharmacovigilance Plan, but for others, the risk may be of a particular nature and seriousness such that they require risk minimisation activities. These activities may be limited to ensuring that adequate precautions are included in the package inserts. However, for some risks, routine activities are not sufficient. If required, these activities must be described in the Risk Minimisation Plan.

f.title: Include a two-part summary of all activities in the RMP

Debe ser realizado en dos partes: • Resumen de todas las actividades (Farmacovigilancia y minimización de riesgo) para cada cuestión importante de seguridad. Debe ser una tabla que enumere cada cuestión de seguridad. • Resumen de todas las actividades y sus objetivos. Esta sección debe ser organizada en forma tal que las actividades llevadas a cabo coincidan con sus objetivos. La razón para esto es que una actividad propuesta puede tratar más de una cuestión de seguridad. Líneas de tiempo y objetivos también se incluyen en el resumen.

It must be done in two parts: • Summary of all activities (Pharmacovigilance and risk minimisation) for each important safety issue. It must be a table listing each safety issue. • Summary of all activities and their objectives. This section must be organised in such a way that the activities carried out match their objectives. The reason for this is that a proposed activity may address more than one safety issue. Timelines and objectives are also included in the summary.

rows.quote_en: Sending of samples: Send the sample in its original packaging, unopened. Samples shall be sent respecting the storage conditions stated on the package and/or package insert. f.title: Complete all sections of the RMP form (Form 10)

f.exceptions: Section 4 and annexes 2 and 3 only if those actions are carried out.

rows.quote: Para la presentación de los PGR se requiere completar el siguiente formulario con los datos que se encuentren disponibles para la especialidad medicinal. Esta estructura sigue los lineamientos para PGR de las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia. La información presentada dependerá de la especialidad medicinal y la etapa del ciclo de vida en que se encuentre la misma. Con excepción de la sección 4, anexos 2 y 3 (que deben ser completados en el caso de que se realicen esas acciones particulares) todas las secciones deben ser presentadas.

This structure follows the PGR guidelines of the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices. The information presented will depend on the medicinal product and the stage of the life cycle it is in. With the exception of section 4 and annexes 2 and 3 (which must be completed if those particular actions are carried out), all sections must be submitted.

f.title: Base post-marketing exposure in the RMP form on market studies and justify the calculation
f.statement: In the RMP form, data on patients exposed during marketing must be obtained, whenever possible, from market studies, and the method used to calculate exposure must be justified.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Los datos de los pacientes expuestos durante la comercialización se deben obtener siempre que sea posible sobre la base de estudios de mercado y se debe justificar la manera de realizar el cálculo de la exposición.
