rows.quote_en: Data on patients exposed during marketing must be obtained whenever possible on the basis of market studies, and the way in which the exposure was calculated must be justified.

f.title: Limit the RMP pharmacovigilance plan to identification actions and justify absence of additional PV activities
f.statement: In the RMP form, the pharmacovigilance plan covers actions to identify or characterise safety problems and must not include actions intended to reduce or prevent risks. For each safety problem a summary of routine and additional pharmacovigilance actions is presented (additional activities may be, e.g., active or stimulated pharmacovigilance and post-marketing studies in Argentina such as drug utilisation studies, sentinel centres or observational studies); when no additional pharmacovigilance activities are required, this must be justified.
f.clause: Anexo II, Formulario 10, 2. Plan de farmacovigilancia
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.quote: El plan de farmacovigilancia abarca acciones destinadas a identificar o caracterizar los problemas de seguridad. No debe incluir acciones destinadas a reducir o prevenir los riesgos. 2.1. Farmacovigilancia de rutina Resumir brevemente el sistema de farmacovigilancia de rutina (ej.: gestión de notificaciones espontáneas, presentación de IPAS, revisión de bibliografía científica nacional e internacional). 2.2. Resumen de los problemas de seguridad y de las acciones de farmacovigilancia (rutina y adicionales) Para cada problema de seguridad presentar un resumen de las acciones de farmacovigilancia de rutina y adicionales. Las actividades adicionales de farmacovigilancia pueden consistir, por ejemplo, en farmacovigilancia activa o estimulada y realización de estudios poscomercialización en Argentina (ejemplo: estudio de utilización de medicamentos, centro centinela, estudios observacionales, entre otros). Justificar cuando no se requieran actividades adicionales de farmacovigilancia.

Summary of safety problems and pharmacovigilance actions (routine and additional). For each safety problem present a summary of routine and additional pharmacovigilance actions. Additional pharmacovigilance activities may consist, for example, of active or stimulated pharmacovigilance and post-marketing studies in Argentina (example: drug utilisation study, sentinel centre, observational studies, among others). Justify when additional pharmacovigilance activities are not required.

f.title: Assess risk minimisation needs for all listed risks in the RMP form and justify routine-only measures
f.statement: In section 3 of the RMP form, the MAH must evaluate the need for risk minimisation activities for all risks listed in point 1.3, justifying whether routine measures (safety information in labels and inserts) are sufficient or additional measures are needed (e.g. educational material, training programmes for physicians, pharmacists and patients, restricted access programme). If additional activities are required, a risk minimisation plan must be presented; when no additional activities are required, this must be justified.
f.clause: Anexo II, Formulario 10, 3. Evaluación de la necesidad de las acciones de minimización de riesgo
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: Se debe evaluar la necesidad de las actividades de minimización de riesgo para todos los riesgos listados en el punto 1.3, y justificar si las acciones de minimización de riesgo de rutina (es decir la información de seguridad contenida en rótulos y prospectos) son suficientes o si son necesarias acciones adicionales de minimización de riesgo (ejemplo: material educativo o programas de formación para médicos, farmacéuticos y pacientes, programa de acceso restringido al medicamento). Si se requieren actividades de minimización de riesgo adicionales presentar un plan de minimización de riesgo. Justificar cuando no se requieran actividades adicionales de minimización de riesgo.

rows.quote_en: The need for risk minimisation activities must be evaluated for all risks listed in point 1.3, and it must be justified whether routine risk minimisation actions (i.e. the safety information contained in labels and package inserts) are sufficient or whether additional risk minimisation actions are necessary (example: educational material or training programmes for physicians, pharmacists and patients, restricted access programme for the medicinal product). If additional risk minimisation activities are required, present a risk minimisation plan. Justify when additional risk minimisation activities are not required.

f.title: Assess potential medication errors from the development phase
f.statement: The MAH must consider medication errors systematically from the development phase, and discuss possible medication errors, their possible cause and actions to avoid them.
f.clause: Anexo II, Formulario 10, 3.2 Errores de medicación potenciales
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote: El TARC debe considerar sistemáticamente la posibilidad de que se cometan errores de medicación teniendo en cuenta las fuentes de error de medicación más comunes. Esta evaluación debe realizarse desde la fase de desarrollo. El TARC debe discutir los posibles errores de medicación, su posible causa y las acciones a tomar para evitar los mismos.
rows.location: Anexo II, Formulario 10, 3.2 Errores de medicación potenciales

rows.quote_en: The TARC must systematically consider the possibility of medication errors being made, taking into account the most common sources of medication error. This evaluation must be carried out from the development phase. The TARC must discuss possible medication errors, their possible cause and the actions to be taken to avoid them.

f.title: Discuss post-marketing medication-error reactions in the RMP update
f.statement: If, after marketing, adverse reactions are shown to occur as a consequence of medication errors, the issue must be discussed in the RMP update.

f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised and marketed in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.quote_en: If, after marketing, it becomes evident that adverse reactions occur as a consequence of medication errors, the matter must be discussed in the PGR update.

f.title: Classify as serious any adverse effect causing death, life-threat, hospitalisation, congenital anomaly or permanent sequelae
f.statement: Serious adverse effect is one that causes death or threatens life, requires or prolongs hospitalisation, produces a congenital anomaly or leaves a permanent sequela.
f.applicability: Definition in the Annex III glossary (approved by Art 3); it determines which cases fall under the 15/7-day expedited reporting of 1.1 b). Original language Spanish.

f.title: Present frequency, seriousness, outcomes, risk factors, mechanisms, preventability and evidence for each important risk in the RMP form

f.title: Choose a suitable post-marketing exposure measure and stratify exposure data in the safety specification
f.statement: When choosing the measure of post-marketing exposure, the MAH is to consider how the medicinal product is used (e.g. patient-years for chronic use; for limited, quantity-driven use such as antibiotics, a count of packs sold may suffice). Mandatory: the exposure information must be stratified by significant variables such as age, indication, dose and duration of treatment.

rows.quote: Cuando se decida qué medida utilizar para medir la exposición es importante considerar cómo se utiliza el medicamento. Por ej., en medicamentos utilizados en uso crónico, la medida apropiada podría ser “paciente años de uso”. Sin embargo, cuando el uso es limitado y generalmente determinado por cantidad, por ej., antibióticos, una suma de los envases vendidos puede ser suficiente. La información debe ser estratificada para variables significativas, como edad, indicación, dosis y duración de tratamiento.

dates.quote: Art. 5° — La presente disposición entrará en vigencia a los treinta (30) días corridos, contados a partir del primer día hábil siguiente al de su publicación en el Boletín Oficial.
dates.quote_en: Art. 5 — This disposition shall enter into force thirty (30) calendar days after, counted from the first business day following its publication in the Official Gazette (Boletín Oficial).
dates.location: Artículo 5; publication data in the page header
dates.timing_note: Published 2013-01-23 (Wednesday); first business day after = 2013-01-24; 30 calendar days counted from 2013-01-24 = 2013-02-23. Expressed as 2013-01-23 + 31 days = 2013-02-23. A reading that counts 24 January as day 1 would give 2013-02-22, hence the lower confidence.
